data_fields.name: entry_interval
data_fields.donor_constant: period, default 200 when unset or not positive

data_fields.name: spawn_rate_multiplier
data_fields.donor_constant: fleet multiplier from gamerules; 0 disables; no upper clamp in parser

data_fields.name: interval_floor
data_fields.donor_constant: none in donor (zero bound makes every draw hit)

data_fields.name: prewarm_threshold
data_fields.donor_constant: 60 per simulated second (one second taken as 60 steps)

data_fields.name: ally_enemy_ratio_guard
data_fields.donor_constant: 2 (allies more than twice enemies blocks; only when an enemy is present)

best_idea: Give each zone a table of spawn entries, each with an interval and a condition gate; scale every interval by one global multiplier, pre-fill a newly entered zone by a few simulated seconds of draws, and block new spawns while friendly groups already outnumber enemies two to one.
decision_why: The per-zone interval table with a condition gate is what row 23 needs as zone data, and one global rate knob is a clean engine value; but the strength-ratio guard and missing interval floor do not fit the MAX_ATTACKERS = 3 ruling, so take the table and knob, add an explicit floor, and cap by attacker count.
acceptance: A server test runs a seeded zone with one entry of interval 600 ticks at multiplier 1 and asserts a spawn count near 10 over 6000 ticks; at a large multiplier the zone floor holds (no more than one spawn per floor period per entry); with more allied groups than twice the hostile groups in the zone, no new group spawns.
